name: Back Room, Mystic Trainer
desc1: This square room is sparsely furnished with two pallets of straw and
desc2: a few shelves containing meagre possessions. A slim, well-built
desc3: Eastern man sits cross-legged in the middle of the room, his eyes
desc4: closed and seeming focused on something you cannot see. As you enter,
desc5: he speaks one silent word, "Welcome", and rises in one fluid motion.
desc6: He bows slightly, and waits. You can exit to the south through a bead
